title: audio_segments
description: Metadata for one clip in public.audio_segments. storage_path is an object key in the public Supabase Storage bucket audio, not a full URL. id and created_at are filled by the database when omitted. This schema validates the metadata row; the audio bytes live in the bucket.

storage_path.description: Object key inside bucket audio. Example: west_point_cornwall/2026/06/10/143000.wav

band_levels.description: Band energy in dB keyed by Hz span, for example {"10-100": 42.1, "100-500": 38.0, "500-2000": 31.4}.
